comments.author: H.-Gazi
comments.body:
***Extra Information***

Rank Tech: 3
Consumed Gauge: 90
Range: 100
Scatter Range: 75

It requires two/three seconds before the Tech will be used.
With advanture job this Tech needs only one second till it activates.

Effect:
Aside from damage, your target(s) will be burned for a longer period (20+ seconds) and deals 25 damage per second + 25% defence reduction. Higher Trap prolongs the "Burn" -effect.

I've learned this from Bounty lv52 npc at Japan West Coast after he used this Tech against me.
